text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Aoi Stakes. The Trainer 
worries about Curren Chan, who has been 
busy keeping all her social media accounts 
updated.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Curren Chan cutely declared that 
she would blow all those worries away.
